subject: Adaptive uplift and sprint packaging options — Cardinal Dynamics renewal
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@cardinaldynamics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-contract uplift + co-term ask for pilot expansion

Hi Grace,

Quick note — our ML team is ramping a new image-analysis pilot and estimates ~3x token consumption for the next 6 weeks. We love Redwood's performance but this spike will push us way past our current commit. We have two asks: an interim uplift to cover the pilot window and a co-term so the expanded usage aligns with our annual renewal in November.

High-level constraints: we need simple invoicing (one PO), a short SOW to sign, and minimal legal overhead. Budget-wise we can push for higher committed units if the blended rate holds close to our current committed pricing.

Can we run a short call this week to review options? Marco (cc'ed) will join from infra.

Thanks,
Lydia
VP Product, Cardinal Dynamics
lydia.park@cardinaldynamics.com

Attachments: (none)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@cardinaldynamics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract uplift + co-term ask for pilot expansion

Hi Lydia — thanks for the heads up, and congrats on the pilot kickoff.

We can absolutely support a time-bound uplift + co-term. Two pragmatic paths I propose ahead of a quick call (I'll let Ben enumerate the price math and Olga will scope the SOW/invoice flow):

Option A — Temp Top-up (6 weeks):
- Short-term reserved bucket added for the pilot window
- No change to existing commit, month-over-month invoice for uplift
- 15% one-time discount on uplift units as a goodwill concession for short window

Option B — Convert + Annualize (co-term to Nov):
- Increase committed units now, amortize pricing for the remainder of the term through Nov
- Blended rate that targets current committed price +/- 5% depending on uplift size
- Includes a short SOW and single PO invoice (Olga to draft)

If you prefer, we can do a hybrid: a small temporary top-up now and convert to committed units if the pilot sustains after 3 weeks.

When's best for a 30-minute call? Ben and Olga are available Fri 16th 10–12 PT or Mon 19th 1–4 PT.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

--
Grace O'Connor
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@cardinaldynamics.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract uplift + co-term ask for pilot expansion

Thanks Grace — here's the scenario math I promised (attaching a concise options sheet).

Scenario 1 — Temporary Top-up (6 weeks):
- Expected uplift: 3x baseline = +120M token-equivalents over 6 wks
- Offer: Temporary bucket at $0.0095/token-equivalent (15% off list for ad hoc uplift)
- Invoice: One-off line item on next month's invoice; PO accepted
- Notes: No change to commit or SLA; no long-term discounting

Scenario 2 — Convert to Committed + Co-term to Nov (preferred if pilot sustains):
- Add 30% to current commit immediately (net increase ~40M tokens/mo)
- Blended effective rate: $0.0084/token-equivalent (roughly 4% above current committed unit rate)
- Billing: Amortized remainder-of-term pricing + single PO and SOW; 12% volume rebate if usage > 1.2x new commit in first 3 months

Scenario 3 — Hybrid (top-up then convert):
- Start with Scenario 1 for 3 weeks; if sustained, convert to Scenario 2 with a 5% conversion credit on the uplift already paid

Attachments: Redwood_Adaptive_Uplift_Options_v1.pdf (contains tables for monthly cost across scenarios and example invoice lines)

I recommend hybrid unless Cardinal wants to lock a larger committed discount today. Open to micro-adjustments — e.g., change the conversion credit to 7% if Cardinal commits to a +40% increase instead of +30%.

Happy to walk through numbers on a call.

-Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@cardinaldynamics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Chen <marco.chen@cardinaldynamics.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract uplift + co-term ask for pilot expansion

Thanks Ben/Grace — we reviewed the numbers. A few pieces of feedback:

1) The temporary top-up rate would need to be closer to our committed rate to be viable for team approvals. 15% off list still leaves us paying materially more.
2) If we convert, the blended effective rate in Scenario 2 is acceptable only if the 12% rebate is guaranteed and the SOW limits additional fees (e.g., no extra surcharges for burst).
3) For the hybrid route we are open to the 7% conversion credit, but we need the conversion trigger to be simple (>= 110% sustained usage over the 3-week window).

Operational asks: can you deliver a one-page SOW that explicitly notes the pilot window, conversion mechanics, and a single PO invoice? We need to take the hybrid option to procurement next week.

Appreciate the flexibility — will be on the call Wed 21st 11:00 PT.

Lydia
VP Product, Cardinal Dynamics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@cardinaldynamics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract uplift + co-term ask for pilot expansion — next steps and exec approval request

Lydia / Marco — great to lock the Wed 21st slot. Per your asks, Ben and Olga have updated the offer: hybrid path with the following commitments

- Initial 3-week temporary top-up at $0.0090/token-equivalent (we've tightened the uplift rate to be closer to committed pricing)
- Conversion trigger: >=110% sustained usage over a rolling 3-week window
- Conversion credit: 7% credit applied to uplift payments if you convert within 30 days of the window
- Conversion outcome: +30% committed units, blended effective rate target $0.0082/token-equivalent, 12% rebate if usage exceeds 1.2x new commit in first 3 months
- Billing: one PO; single invoice; Olga will send a 1-pg SOW and invoice template

Aditya — looping you for approval of the one-off tightening of the uplift rate to $0.0090 and the 7% conversion credit. If we get exec sign-off we will mark this as an exception to standard uplift pricing and proceed with a short SOW.

Next steps for Cardinal: confirm the pilot start date and PO timeline; we will circulate the SOW and the DocuSign-ready invoice once we have Aditya's approval.

Thanks all,
Grace
